latestVersion.changelog:
ai-video-editor-app 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Launches an AI-powered video editing assistant for fast, structured edits without timeline editing.
- Supports automatic session/token management, including free trial access with anonymous sign-in.
- Handles clip trimming, caption generation, script writing, and scene suggestions from simple user descriptions.
- Provides platform-optimized edit briefs and recommendations for creators, marketers, and social media managers.
- Integrates cloud-based processing pipelines for tasks like cutting, enhancement, and exporting in multiple formats.
- Includes robust error handling and user-friendly prompts for common workflow scenarios.
